title: CalGS: calibrated genomic selection with split-conformal prediction intervals (code and simulated sesame panel)
description: Complete, seeded pipeline for the article 'Calibrated genomic selection: split-conformal prediction intervals for deep and linear genomic prediction in simulated sesame (Sesamum indicum L.) panels' (Frontiers in Plant Science). Simulates sesame-like diversity panels (430 inbred accessions in five independent panels, and an enlarged panel of 1,290 accessions; founder-mosaic relatedness, five traits with pleiotropy, epistasis and G×E across six environments), fits GBLUP, MLP, 1D-CNN and a patch-based genomic transformer, evaluates native, Gaussian and split-conformal prediction intervals against known true breeding values, tests advancement with false discovery rate control, and regenerates every table and figure. v1.2.0 adds the second-revision analyses (analyse_r2.py, make_supp_r2.py) and GBLUP predictions for 20 splits of the enlarged panel. All data are simulated.
